#define ZSTD_PTHREAD_MUTEX_LOCK(mutex) {          \
    if (ZSTD_DEBUG >= MUTEX_WAIT_TIME_DLEVEL) {   \
        ZSTD_pthread_mutex_lock(mutex);           \
    } else {                                      \
        ZSTD_pthread_mutex_lock(mutex);           \
    }                                             \
